faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Joining the waitlist and using Encorely at launch is free. Optional premium features will come later.
faq.q2: Do I need Spotify to use it?
faq.a2: Spotify is the heart of the match: that's where your music DNA comes from. We recommend connecting it for the best experience.
faq.q3: What do you do with my data?
faq.a3: We only use your listening signals to calculate compatibility. We don't sell your data or post anything without your permission.
faq.a4: We're in the final tweaks. Join the list and you'll be among the first to get access in your city.
faq.a5: No. Encorely is about connecting with like-minded fans —friendship, concert plans or whatever comes up— without the pressure of a dating app.
